title: Theme System Restoration & Hallucination Prevention
executive_summary: Successfully restored two-layer theme system after regression, fixed 7 critical bugs blocking dashboard, and improved AI hallucination prevention through honest verification practices. Achieved 7/7 unanimous crew approval for architectural solution.
key_topics: Two-layer theme system architecture (dashboard + project isolation)

critical_decisions.rationale: Separation of concerns is fundamental. Dashboard and projects are distinct domains that should not contaminate each other's themes. GlobalThemeStyles was applying theme to entire document.documentElement, breaking iframe isolation.
critical_decisions.implementation: Scope CSS variables to .dashboard-theme-wrapper class, maintain project.theme in iframe URL params, ensure independence
critical_decisions.outcome: Dashboard has independent theme, each project maintains its own theme in live preview, no cross-contamination

critical_decisions.decision: Implement hallucination prevention through real verification
critical_decisions.rationale: AI was claiming success without verification - showing fancy boxes instead of real logs, assuming endpoints worked without testing. User called out: 'I think our hallucination prevention system needs work'
critical_decisions.implementation: Always check server logs after changes, wait for compilation, verify HTTP responses, show actual output, be honest when broken, don't claim 'working' until user confirms
critical_decisions.outcome: More reliable AI assistance, honest status reporting, user trust maintained
critical_decisions.lessons_learned: Verification beats assumption. Real logs beat pretty boxes. User feedback is the ultimate ground truth.

bugs_fixed.error: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
bugs_fixed.cause: n8n webhook returning empty response, response.json() failed on empty data
bugs_fixed.fix: Added text parsing before JSON.parse(), check for empty responses, graceful fallback to null

bugs_fixed.error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, .next/server/...
bugs_fixed.cause: Corrupted Next.js build cache after code changes
'use client' directive at top of page.tsx (incompatible with Next.js App Router)
bugs_fixed.fix: Remove 'use client' from server component wrapper (child component already has it)

bugs_fixed.error: ssr: false not allowed in Server Components
bugs_fixed.cause: Next.js 15 doesn't allow ssr: false in Server Components
bugs_fixed.fix: Remove ssr: false option from dynamic import (redundant when child has 'use client')

bugs_fixed.error: Theme controls missing from navigation bar
bugs_fixed.cause: ThemeSelector component existed but wasn't imported or used
bugs_fixed.fix: Import ThemeSelector, add to header with globalTheme and updateGlobalTheme

bugs_fixed.error: Theme selector doesn't update dashboard colors
bugs_fixed.cause: Using hardcoded THEME_MAP instead of proper theme-colors.js system
bugs_fixed.fix: Replace with getThemeColors() and isThemeDark(), support all 12+ themes

bugs_fixed.cause: CSS variables applied to document.documentElement (global scope)
bugs_fixed.fix: Scope to .dashboard-theme-wrapper class only, render inline <style> tag

technical_patterns_discovered.description: Always parse response.text() first, check for empty, then JSON.parse() with try/catch
technical_patterns_discovered.use_when: Parsing API responses that might be empty or malformed
technical_patterns_discovered.code_example: const text = await response.text(); if (!text || text.trim() === '') return null; try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return null; }

technical_patterns_discovered.description: Dashboard and projects have independent themes via scoped CSS classes
technical_patterns_discovered.use_when: Multi-domain applications where each domain needs independent styling
technical_patterns_discovered.architecture: Layer 1 (.dashboard-theme-wrapper) for dashboard UI, Layer 2 (iframe documents) for project content

technical_patterns_discovered.description: Server Components can't have 'use client' or 'ssr: false' - use dynamic import of client components instead
technical_patterns_discovered.code_example: const Component = dynamic(() => import('./client-comp')); // client-comp.tsx has 'use client'

technical_patterns_discovered.description: When Next.js shows ENOENT errors for .next files, delete .next directory for fresh rebuild
technical_patterns_discovered.use_when: Next.js build corruption after code changes

knowledge_base_entries.title: Two-Layer Theme System Architecture
knowledge_base_entries.content: Dashboard applications with project previews need independent theme management. Layer 1: Dashboard theme (scoped to .dashboard-theme-wrapper class) controls UI, navigation, cards. Layer 2: Project themes (isolated in iframes) control project content. CSS variables must be scoped to prevent contamination. Each layer has its own theme selector and storage.

knowledge_base_entries.title: Hallucination Prevention Through Verification
knowledge_base_entries.content: AI agents should verify success before claiming it. Pattern: Make change → wait for build/compilation → check logs for errors → verify HTTP responses → show actual output → wait for user confirmation. Never claim 'working' or 'ready' without verification. Real logs beat fancy status boxes. User feedback is ground truth.
knowledge_base_entries.user_insight: Critical feedback that improved system reliability

knowledge_base_entries.title: Next.js 15 App Router Patterns
knowledge_base_entries.content: Next.js 15 App Router has strict rules: (1) page.tsx files are Server Components by default, cannot have 'use client' at top level. (2) Server Components cannot use ssr: false option. (3) Use dynamic(() => import('./client-comp')) to load Client Components from Server Components. (4) Child component should have 'use client' directive. (5) Build cache (.next) can corrupt - delete when seeing ENOENT errors.
